title: Asia’s premier trading card venture
lede: Grade10 is backed by <memeStrategy>MemeStrategy</memeStrategy> (HKEX: 2440) and founded by the team behind <nineGag>9GAG</nineGag>, a global platform with over 200 million users. That lineage fuels our mission: to build Asia’s largest, most dynamic card collector community and a seamless, one-stop ecosystem where passion thrives.

story.innovation: Since 2023, Grade10 has led innovation in the category. We host Hong Kong’s largest card shows, provide professional <vault>vaulting services</vault>, and give collectors our proprietary <grade10Ai>Grade10 AI</grade10Ai> tool for real-time pricing and research. We have also tokenized trading cards on the blockchain for stronger authenticity and liquidity.
story.ambition: Our ambition is boundless. Expanding into the Chinese Mainland through strategic partnerships and establishing a presence in Korea and beyond, Grade10 is rapidly evolving into Asia’s preeminent trading card powerhouse, setting new industry benchmarks and enriching every collector’s journey.

memeStrategy.title: About MemeStrategy
memeStrategy.heritage: MemeStrategy, Inc. (HKEX: 2440) is a pioneer in the cultural collectibles and intellectual property (IP) sector in Asia. Founded by the team behind 9GAG, a globally renowned meme platform with over 200 million users, the company brings over 18 years of experience in shaping internet culture and social media. That heritage gives it a unique position at the intersection of digital innovation and traditional fandom culture.
memeStrategy.history: In March 2025 it completed a comprehensive brand revamp, and in September it entered the Asian trading card market by acquiring Grade10, Asia’s renowned collectible card brand. In March 2026 it issued the world’s first tokenized Pokémon trading card fund, and it continues to pioneer the financialization of cultural assets. MemeStrategy is set to launch <finance>Grade10 Finance</finance> in Q4 2026, Asia’s first trading card financing service by a listed company, further unlocking liquidity for collectors and deepening its collectibles financial ecosystem.
